STRATEGY: Parent cooperates until remaining <=5, then defects; it forgives single defections when opponent is mostly cooperative and mirrors TFT-like opponents. The trace simulates parent and a new strategy against Always C, TFT-like slots, Always D, and Grim Trigger. It changes the new strategy by adding a one-time test after 10 mutual cooperations, streak-based forgiveness, and endgame defection at n>=95.

Changed by adding a one-time test at round 10, then exploiting if opponent never defects, and switching to permanent cooperation once opponent retaliates.
